messages.author: a387d7985c232d82
messages.subject: Wrong Version Message for CmdStan?
parts:
Hello all,

I just downloaded and installed CmdStan v2.8.0, and I noticed that the message following a successful build is "CmdStan v2.7.0 built". Perhaps that is a typo?

(I am running OS X Yosemite on a 2013 Mac Pro.)

Devin

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Wrong Version Message for CmdStan?
parts:
Hi Devin,

Yes, that's a typo. Thanks for bringing it to my attention. I'll have it fixed for the next release.


Daniel
